findings.evidence: `rg -n "relativeProdHom_apply_apply|prodHom_apply_apply"` finds `prodHom_apply_apply` at lines 77-79 with lhs `prodHom ... p x`, but `relativeProdHom_apply_apply` at lines 138-142 has lhs `Prod.map ... x`; Mathlib only confirms `Diffeomorph.prodCongr` coerces to `Prod.map` (`Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/Diffeomorph.lean:547`).
findings.fix: Change the theorem statement to `(relativeProdHom (I := I) (J := J) (n := n) s t p : (M × N) ≃ₘ^n⟮I.prod J, I.prod J⟯ M × N) x = ((p.1 : M ≃ₘ^n⟮I, I⟯ M) x.1, (p.2 : N ≃ₘ^n⟮J, J⟯ N) x.2)`.
findings.issue: `relativeProdHom_apply_apply` is documented and named as the pointwise formula for `relativeProdHom`, but its statement never applies `relativeProdHom`; the lhs is only `Prod.map ... x`.

summary: One advertised pointwise API theorem for the relative product homomorphism is mis-formalized: it proves a `Prod.map` identity instead of a formula for `relativeProdHom`.
